properties.name: MEASURED before merge: 30 of 1,003 scanned nodes carry an unfiled prohibition — half the regex estimate, and the difference is exactly what the rule refuses to nudge
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-09-14 on reflow2's committed export (4,477 nodes) with the shipped detector, before merge.

THE NUMBER: 30 of 1,003 scanned nodes — Requirement 14, Capability 9, accepted Decision 7; Component 0, Interface 0. One aggregate finding at severity 0.35, among 35 gaps in the whole design.

WHY IT IS HALF THE MORNING'S ESTIMATE. fact:capture-is-blind-to-three-families-… estimated ≈61 from a regex over EVERY node's prose including ChangeEvents, TemporalFacts, Verifications, brainstormed Decisions and the rationale field, then sampled 9/10 genuine. The shipped rule excludes all of those on purpose: records and checks are not intent, a proposed Decision's "must never" is a musing the brainstorm skill says not to nudge, and a rationale is the why. So ≈31 of the 61 were sentences the detector is DESIGNED not to raise, and the 30 that remain are the ones a reader should actually file or dismiss. The estimate was right about the practice and loose about the population; the rule is the tighter statement.

WHAT THE 30 LOOK LIKE (from the evidence line): cap:describe-design-at-path ("something-unnamed must never read as nothing-here"), cap:capture-registers-its-source, cap:a-session-reports-the-work-it-did-by-hand ("the report must never become telemetry"), cap:a-declared-wall-is-checked-against-the-coupling-it-contains, req:the-kind-of-system-is-established-before-its-parts-are-captured ("it must never determine which analyses reflow2 will run") — standing house prohibitions, each of which a Constraint could bind to the node it governs and a check could then read.

FALSIFIED BOTH WAYS, run not assumed: detector disabled → 5 of 11 fail (every positive); every exclusion widened at once → 5 of 11 fail (every exclusion). The remaining test (parked, silence) cannot fail by construction and says so.

BOUNDS: one design, a self-host. Six phrases; "shall not" and the closed-set row deliberately outside. Whether the 30 SHOULD become Constraints is the reader's ruling, not this record's.
